target_vertical: DTC e-commerce brands, multi-channel retailers, light manufacturers, FBA sellers (DACH-focused)
pricing_model: Tiered subscription (Launch / Business / Pro / Enterprise); unlimited users included; mandatory onboarding fee; entry tier includes a per-order fee at the Launch tier; ~10% discount on annual contracts
starting_price_usd: Approx. USD ~108/month (EUR 99/month) for the Launch tier (24-month term, EUR 0.30/order); mandatory onboarding fee of approx. EUR 1,990
free_trial_or_freemium: No public freemium tier; demos and guided onboarding offered (no published self-serve free trial)
shopify_install_count: Approx. 5 reviews on the Shopify App Store listing (low review volume; most installs are driven through Xentral onboarding rather than Shopify App Store) [uncertain]
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional for orders, inventory, and product data; tracking/fulfillment pushed from Xentral to Shopify; stock pushed Xentral -> Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products (incl. variants/matrix products), inventory/stock levels, customer sales orders (with customer, shipping method, payment method), customers, shipments/tracking numbers, invoices; refunds and returns handled via Xentral's returns module rather than a deep Shopify refund sync
shopify_service_item_support: [uncertain] — Xentral supports non-physical items internally; explicit Shopify service-item sync parity (akin to Katana 2025) is not documented
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — multiple Shopify connections can be configured per Xentral tenant
shopify_pos_support: [uncertain] — no clear Shopify POS-specific integration documented; focus is online store sync
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: [uncertain] — Xentral supports B2B order workflows generally, but native handling of Shopify Plus B2B catalogs / company locations / price lists is not explicitly documented
shopify_markets_support: [uncertain] — no explicit documentation of Shopify Markets multi-market pricing / duties / landed cost awareness
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: Configurable field mapping via Xentral Connect / Smarty templating allows custom field/metafield transformation, but not a turnkey metafield mapper like Brightpearl [uncertain on full parity]
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Supports Shopify variants and matrix/variant products; SKU-based mapping between Shopify variant SKU and Xentral article number
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Polled/batched via Process Starter; stock pushed approx. every 15 minutes by default (configurable); orders imported at configurable intervals. Webhook support is being introduced via the new Xentral API (behind feature flag)
shopify_known_limitations: Default polling-based sync (not pure real-time) can cause minor lag; Shopify Plus-specific features (B2B catalogs, Markets, POS) not deeply integrated; complex variant/metafield mapping often requires Xentral Connect / Smarty customization; older Shopify Classic connector is being superseded by the new Connect-based integration
etsy_native_or_third_party: No first-party native Etsy connector; integration typically delivered via Shopimporter API endpoint or via marketplace partners / Xentral Connect apps
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync-only (orders and basic item data); listing creation on Etsy is not a documented Xentral capability [uncertain]
etsy_inventory_sync: [uncertain] — stock sync to Etsy depends on the specific partner connector used
etsy_order_import: Orders imported via the Shopimporter / partner connector on a scheduled basis
etsy_synced_entities: Primarily orders and basic item mapping; variations and personalization handling depends on the partner connector [uncertain]
etsy_known_limitations: No first-party Etsy app; depth of variations, personalization and digital-product handling depends on third-party connector; less mature than Xentral's Shopify/Amazon integrations
amazon_marketplaces: All major Amazon marketplaces supported via SP-API (EU marketplaces including DE/UK/FR/IT/ES/NL/PL/SE, plus US, CA, MX, AU, JP) [uncertain on full marketplace list]
amazon_seller_types: FBA, FBM, and mixed; Vendor Central support [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings (linked via Amazon Seller App), inventory/stock (per FBA warehouse country and condition, e.g. FBA-FR-sellable), orders, shipments, invoices, settlements/payouts (via accounting/Amainvoice integration), returns
amazon_listing_creation: Primarily syncs existing listings; listing creation from Xentral is limited and typically handled in Seller Central [uncertain]
amazon_repricing_support: Not included natively; relies on third-party repricers
amazon_buy_shipping: [uncertain] — no public documentation of an in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label feature equivalent to Veeqo
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: FBA inbound shipments can be created/managed via the Amazon Seller App connection; FBA stock is imported per country/condition with auto-created storage locations. Specific detail on whether the workflow is built on Fulfillment Inbound v2024-03-20 API is not publicly disclosed [uncertain]
amazon_sp_api_inbound_v2024_03_20: [uncertain] — Xentral uses Amazon SP-API but public status on migration to the new v2024-03-20 inbound API is not documented
amazon_settlement_report_handling: Settlement reports are typically processed via partner integrations such as Amainvoice/Taxdoo, which then post journals to DATEV / Xero / QuickBooks; Xentral generates the underlying invoices and feeds them out
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Marketplace-facilitator VAT handled via VAT logic that recognizes which Amazon warehouse shipped the order and applies the correct VAT to the invoice; cross-border / OSS handling supported, often combined with Taxdoo / Amainvoice for compliance
amazon_multi_account_support: Yes — multiple Amazon seller accounts/stores can be linked, each with its own workflow configuration
amazon_known_limitations: Listing creation/management in Xentral is limited compared to specialist listing tools; repricing not included; FBA workflow heavily relies on linking via the Amazon Seller App and storage-location naming conventions; advanced settlement-level accounting typically requires Taxdoo/Amainvoice add-ons
xero_app_store_certified: [uncertain] — interface to Xero is documented in Xentral, but a current Xero App Store certified listing is not clearly confirmed
xero_synced_entities: Invoices, credit notes, payments, and posting records exported to Xero; primarily AR/AP document flow rather than deep COGS / inventory adjustment journals
xero_accounting_sync_mode: Invoice-per-order export model (Xentral generates the invoice/credit note and pushes it to Xero); summary-journal style accounting is typically handled via DATEV/Taxdoo rather than Xero directly [uncertain]
xero_cogs_journal_method: [uncertain] — Xentral computes calculated purchase price (incl. landed cost components) internally; explicit perpetual-per-movement COGS journal posting to Xero is not clearly documented
xero_multi_currency: [uncertain] — Xentral supports multi-currency and Xero supports multi-currency; combined behavior not explicitly documented
xero_tax_handling: Tax codes mapped per document; VAT logic supports EU OSS scenarios; specific Xero tax code mapping configuration [uncertain]
xero_known_limitations: Xentral's accounting integration story is heavily DATEV-centric (DATEV Premium Partner); Xero is supported as an export target but with less depth than DATEV; advanced features like tracking categories and detailed COGS journals are not prominently documented
qb_desktop_supported: [uncertain] — no clear QuickBooks Desktop integration documented
qb_synced_entities: Invoices, credit notes, and payments exported to QuickBooks; customer/vendor records as needed
qb_known_limitations: QuickBooks integration is less mature/marketed than DATEV; depth of journal/COGS/class mapping is not clearly documented; primarily document-export rather than deep accounting sync
other_ecom_channels: WooCommerce (native via Xentral Connect), Shopware (5 and 6), Magento, eBay, Kaufland, OTTO, Galaxus, TikTok Shop (incl. Fulfilled by TikTok), JTL, Gambio, Shopify, Amazon, and custom storefronts via the Shopimporter API; numerous additional marketplaces via partner Connect apps
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — Xentral supports product bundles and BOMs; selling a bundle decrements components, and components can be assembled into the bundle SKU (standard and just-in-time BOM modes)
other_accounting_integrations: DATEV (Premium Partner — primary accounting integration), Lexware, Sage, Taxdoo (VAT compliance), Amainvoice (Amazon settlements). FreshBooks, MYOB, Wave, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Zoho Books: not standard [uncertain]
bom_support: Yes — full bill-of-materials support including standard and just-in-time BOMs
multi_level_bom: Yes — multi-level / nested BOMs supported (header product produced from sub-products which can themselves have BOMs)
production_orders: Yes — production module with work orders, work steps/instructions, post-calculation, and time tracking; suitable for light manufacturing/assembly
batch_lot_tracking: Yes — batch numbers and best-before / expiry dates fully supported, including capture on mobile
serial_tracking: Yes — serial numbers tracked through purchase, production (component-to-product serial mapping), and shipping
bin_location_support: Yes — storage locations including sub-locations / bins; auto-created per FBA country/condition where applicable
multi_warehouse: Yes — unlimited storage locations / warehouses supported
barcoding: Yes — barcode generation/printing and barcode/QR scanning via the Mobile Picking App (smartphone camera or compatible Zebra/Honeywell/Sunmi devices); external Bluetooth scanners not supported on the mobile picking app
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, partial receipts, supplier price lists, auto-generated POs from sales/stock triggers
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records with lead times, supplier-SKU mapping, supplier price lists, and procurement workflows
landed_cost_support: Yes — Calculated Purchase Price (CP) supports inclusion of customs duties, logistics and shipping costs; flows into margin and inventory valuation; BOM-based aggregation also supported
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: [uncertain] — Xentral supports multi-currency transactions; whether inventory valuation is maintained per-currency or only in base currency is not clearly documented
ai_demand_forecasting: [uncertain] — Xentral is positioning itself as an 'AI ERP' with agentic AI features in roadmap (auto-reorder suggestions, dynamic pricing nudges); a generally-available demand-forecasting product feature is not clearly documented as of 2026
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes (emerging) — AI agents are being introduced that monitor inventory and propose reorders with human-in-the-loop confirmation; replenishment suggestions are part of the AI ERP roadmap
ai_natural_language_query: [uncertain] — integrated AI in the reporting module is referenced; a fully general 'ask your inventory' chat experience is not clearly documented
public_api: Yes — public REST API documented at developer.xentral.com with OpenAPI 3.0 spec on GitHub (xentral/api-spec-public); new Xentral API replaces the legacy API
webhook_event_coverage: Webhooks available via the new API (behind a feature flag at developer.xentral.com/reference/webhooks); event coverage expanding; legacy integration is poll-based via Process Starter
integration_architecture: Native first-party connectors plus Xentral Connect middleware (in-platform iPaaS-style app marketplace); partner-built connectors available in the Xentral Marketplace; public REST API for custom builds
zapier_make_support: [uncertain] — third-party Zapier/Make connectors exist via the public API and partner apps, but no first-party Zapier/Make listing is prominently documented
mobile_app: Yes — Xentral Mobile Picking App for iOS and Android focused on pick & pack, stocktake, batch/serial/best-before capture
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Yes — Mobile Picking App scans 1D barcodes and 2D/QR codes via phone camera or compatible Android handheld devices (Zebra, Honeywell, Sunmi)
rate_limit_handling_documented: [uncertain] — Xentral's own API rate limits are referenced in developer docs; explicit documentation of how Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO throttling is handled internally is not prominently published
sync_frequency: Shopify: ~15 min polling for stock by default (configurable); order import on configurable interval. Amazon: scheduled SP-API polling. Xero/QuickBooks: document export on event/batch. Webhook-driven real-time available for selected events via new API (feature-flagged)
shipping_carrier_integrations: DHL, DPD, UPS, GLS, Hermes directly; 100+ additional carriers via Sendcloud integration; Shipcloud, Easybill, and additional carrier connectors via Xentral Marketplace
shipping_label_buying: Yes — shipping labels can be generated in Xentral via integrated carrier connections and Sendcloud (requires active carrier/Sendcloud contracts)
three_pl_integrations: Supports 3PL handoffs via custom integrations and the public API; Amazon FBA is treated as a 3PL-style warehouse; specific native ShipBob/ShipHero connectors [uncertain]
edi_support: [uncertain] — EDI is typically delivered via partner connectors rather than as a first-party module
g2_rating: Listed on G2; aggregate rating not explicitly captured in research [uncertain]
capterra_rating: Approx. 4.5 / 5 on Capterra; 4.1 / 5 on OMR Reviews with ~177 reviews [uncertain on exact current counts]
notable_customers: Used by numerous DACH DTC brands including (publicly referenced) YFood, KoRo, the Female Company, Lillydoo, Pink Gellac, AirUp, Lottie London and others [uncertain on full current customer list]
last_major_release: 2025-2026: positioning as 'AI ERP for Scaling Commerce Businesses', rollout of AI agents (purchasing, disposition, accounting), new Xentral API and webhooks (feature-flagged), and continued migration from Shopify Classic to the Xentral Connect-based Shopify integration [uncertain on exact release dates]
owner_parent_company: Independent company (Xentral ERP Software GmbH); venture-backed (Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, Meritech Capital, Visionaries Club, Freigeist Capital); no public acquisition by a parent
last_funding_event: Series B of USD 75M led by Tiger Global and Meritech, with participation from Sequoia, Visionaries Club, Freigeist — announced August 2021; no publicly announced subsequent priced round through 2026 [uncertain]
public_status_page_uptime: [uncertain] — no widely-publicized public status page URL identified in research
